name: Haikyuu Escape Room
source:
You end up in an escape room as part of a "team bonding exercise" with the Karasuno VBC. Will you be able to escape in time and build your own bonds with the team in the process? Test your skills and see if you have what it takes!

[From [url=https://mooncreates.itch.io/haikyuu-escape-room]Itch.io[/url]]
